data.one_liner: Provides data for world currencies in the form of sealed classes.
data.what_it_does: Provides information about world currencies in the form of compile-time, tree-shakable constant classes with a sealed origin. It contains ISO 4217 codes, numeric codes, English and native names, units, subunits, and currency name translations.
use_when: You need comprehensive ISO 4217 currency data with built-in translations.
You want compile-time constant, tree-shakable currency definitions.
avoid_when: You need real-time currency exchange rates or financial conversion APIs.
You need Flutter-ready widgets like currency pickers (use world_countries instead).
strengths: Sealed class hierarchy guarantees exhaustive pattern matching and compile-time safety.
Extensive translation support and high code coverage.
weaknesses: Does not include live currency exchange rates or conversion APIs.
